findings.highlight: Kotomine jumps in through the window I broke.
findings.evidenceJa: 外套をはためかせて言峰が飛び込んできた
findings.governingReading: Kotomine leaps through Shirou’s broken window with his cloak fluttering.
findings.explanation: The English removes the conspicuous motion of Kotomine’s cloak from his entrance.

findings.highlight: WhaIllya……!!!!
findings.governingReading: Shirou’s cry breaks off before Illya’s name in alarm.
findings.explanation: The English splices the interruption into her name as malformed “WhaIllya.”

findings.highlight: Illya is in his arms.
findings.evidenceJa: 言峰に抱かれたまま地上に降りたイリヤは
findings.governingReading: Illya reaches the ground still held in Kotomine’s arms, then immediately throws off his hand.
findings.explanation: The English converts the completed descent into a static pose and weakens the action sequence.

findings.highlight: She hit him so hard that I can hear it from up here.
findings.evidenceJa: 実にいい音をさせている
findings.governingReading: The slap makes an exceptionally fine, clearly audible sound.
findings.explanation: The English infers exceptional striking force from the quality and audibility of the sound.

findings.highlight: In a normal house
findings.evidenceJa: 日本の建物なら
findings.governingReading: In a Japanese building, the drop would unquestionably correspond to roughly the eighth floor.
findings.explanation: The English replaces the Japanese-building scale comparison with a normal house.

findings.highlight: I would’ve broken my legs
findings.evidenceJa: 足の骨に罅でも入って
findings.governingReading: On asphalt, he might at least have cracked a leg bone.
findings.explanation: The English pluralizes the injury and escalates a possible crack into definitely broken legs.

findings.highlight: makes me forget about the pain
findings.evidenceJa: 足の痺れを忘れさせる
findings.governingReading: Kotomine’s remark is outrageous enough to make Shirou forget the numbness in his legs.
findings.explanation: The English changes numbness into pain.

findings.highlight: I almost fainted right when I started the jump
findings.evidenceJa: 飛び降りた瞬間なんて目眩で失神しかけた
findings.governingReading: At the instant Shirou jumped down, vertigo nearly made him faint.
findings.explanation: The English moves the near-faint from the instant of the drop to when he started the jump and omits vertigo.

findings.highlight: the sword I left here
findings.evidenceJa: 登り際に置いていった剣
findings.governingReading: The sword is the one Shirou left behind when he began climbing.
findings.explanation: The English omits when and why the sword was left.

findings.highlight: an honorable, yet ruthless, lord
findings.evidenceJa: 親切で無慈悲な城の主
findings.governingReading: The castle’s master is paradoxically kind and merciless in announcing death to fleeing prisoners.
findings.explanation: The English replaces kindness with honorability and mercilessness with the less absolute “ruthless.”

findings.highlight: every last ounce of composure is squeezed from my body
findings.evidenceJa: 細胞という細胞から余裕が搾り出されていく
findings.governingReading: At Berserker’s name, all margin for composure is wrung out of every cell in Shirou’s body.
findings.explanation: The English preserves squeezing but removes the cell-by-cell bodily image.

findings.highlight: Forget about him, Berserker isn’t like before
findings.evidenceJa: 諦めろ、バーサーカーは以前とは違う
findings.governingReading: Shirou tells Illya to give Berserker up because he is no longer as he was.
findings.explanation: “Forget about him” weakens the demand to abandon hope of recovering or relying on Berserker.

findings.highlight: for the whole three hours to the forest’s edge
findings.evidenceJa: 森の出口まで最短の三時間
findings.governingReading: Even by the shortest route, reaching the forest exit takes three hours.
findings.explanation: The English presents three hours as a fixed duration and omits that it is the minimum possible time.

findings.highlight: is overtaking us
findings.evidenceJa: すぐそこまで追ってくる
findings.governingReading: The darkness is pursuing them and has already drawn immediately near.
findings.explanation: The English says it is overtaking them, changing proximity into relative motion.

findings.highlight: a black wall bearing down to engulf us
findings.evidenceJa: 真っ黒い壁が少しずつ速度をあげ
findings.governingReading: The imagined pitch-black wall gradually gathers speed as it drives forward to swallow them.
findings.explanation: The English omits the gradual acceleration that creates the tactical danger.

findings.highlight: The enemy’s speed and ours are about the same.
findings.evidenceJa: 壁の速度と俺の速度はほぼ同じ
findings.governingReading: The wall’s speed is nearly equal to Shirou’s own speed.
findings.explanation: The English changes a comparison with Shirou individually into one with the group, despite Illya already forcing him to slow.

findings.highlight: He’ll catch up to us in a minute
findings.evidenceJa: 一分もしないうちに間違いなく追いつかれる
findings.governingReading: If Shirou carries Illya, they will unquestionably be caught in less than a minute.
findings.explanation: The English changes under a minute to in a minute and omits certainty.

findings.highlight: One little girl’s weight is nothing
findings.evidenceJa: イリヤ一人ならどうってことない
findings.governingReading: Shirou insists that carrying Illya alone is no problem.
findings.explanation: The English adds an explicit claim about her weight and inserts “little girl” where the source names Illya.

findings.highlight: with this borrowed sword
findings.evidenceJa: こんな借り受けただけの細剣一本で
findings.governingReading: Shirou imagines facing the strongest Servant with only one slender sword that he merely borrowed.
findings.explanation: The English omits the sword’s slenderness, the single-weapon limit, and the dismissive “merely.”

findings.highlight: my torso crushed by strength like a machine, all while I’m still conscious
findings.evidenceJa: まだ意識がのこったままの上半身を工事現場の機械みたいにズバーングシャーンと木っ端微塵、跡形も無く踏み潰され
findings.governingReading: Shirou imagines his still-conscious upper half being stamped utterly out of existence like construction machinery, with explosive comic sound effects.
findings.explanation: The English reduces a specific, grotesquely comic annihilation image to a torso crushed by machine-like strength.

findings.highlight: Kotomine walks over to us
findings.evidenceJa: ここまで戻って来たかと思うと
findings.governingReading: Kotomine has doubled back and returned as far as Shirou and Illya.
findings.explanation: The English changes a tactical return into merely walking over.

findings.highlight: picks Illya up, and starts running
findings.evidenceJa: 有無を言わさず、イリヤを抱えて走り出した
findings.governingReading: Without allowing either of them any say, Kotomine takes Illya and runs.
findings.explanation: The English omits Kotomine’s decisive refusal to permit objection.

findings.highlight: at a pace of a hundred meters per seven seconds
findings.evidenceJa: 百メートルを七秒台で走り抜ける
findings.governingReading: They cover one hundred meters in the seven-second range.
findings.explanation: The English uses the malformed rate “per seven seconds” and loses the range rather than exact-time nuance.

findings.highlight: My left arm throbs.
findings.evidenceJa: 腕が震動する
findings.governingReading: Shirou’s arm vibrates.
findings.explanation: The English changes mechanical vibration into a pulse or throb.

findings.highlight: It feels like my left arm expanded beneath the cloth.
findings.evidenceJa: どくん、と大きく膨張するかのような違和感
findings.governingReading: He feels a disturbing, heavy beat as though the wrapped arm swelled greatly.
findings.explanation: The English removes the onomatopoeic beat, disturbing abnormality, and magnitude.

findings.highlight: His physical abilities are flowing into me now.
findings.evidenceJa: 肉体的な機能まで衛宮士郎を侵している
findings.governingReading: Even Archer’s bodily functions are invading Emiya Shirou.
findings.explanation: The English turns hostile bodily encroachment into neutral abilities flowing into him.

findings.highlight: contamination too great for a Geiger counter to measure
findings.evidenceJa: 放射能漏れでガイガーカウンターとかいうそこはかとなく格好よさげなメーターを振り切らせる
findings.governingReading: Even if it is like a radiation leak pegging one of those vaguely cool-looking meters called a Geiger counter, Shirou is grateful now.
findings.explanation: The English removes the radiation leak, needle-pegging image, and Shirou’s joke about the meter’s faintly cool name.

findings.highlight: Not as much as you.
findings.evidenceJa: おまえ程ではない
findings.governingReading: Kotomine retorts that he is no less human than Shirou, or that Shirou is the stranger case.
findings.explanation: The English leaves “not as much as you” without the property being compared, making the exchange incoherent.

findings.highlight: The trees in the forest are like pebbles beneath his feet.
findings.evidenceJa: 森の木々などバーサーカーには小石程度の足止めにしかならん
findings.governingReading: For Berserker, the forest trees delay him no more than pebbles would.
findings.explanation: The English relocates the comparison beneath his feet and weakens its explicit function as a negligible impediment.

findings.highlight: talking about this with such disinterest
findings.evidenceJa: 今の立場なら幸運と喜ぶべき事をつまらなげに語る
findings.governingReading: Kotomine speaks dully about something their present position should make him welcome as good fortune.
findings.explanation: The English retains disinterest but omits why it is striking: he should be pleased by this fortunate circumstance.

findings.highlight: A voice filled with hostility.
findings.evidenceJa: 殺気に満ちた声
findings.governingReading: Kotomine’s voice is filled with killing intent.
findings.explanation: The English weakens imminent lethal intent into general hostility.

findings.highlight: I see a white skull.
findings.evidenceJa: 白い髑髏が見えた
findings.governingReading: Shirou sees Assassin’s white skull mask.
findings.explanation: The English names a literal skull and omits the mask worn by Assassin.

findings.highlight: raising his left arm over his head
findings.evidenceJa: 僅かに左腕を振りかぶり
findings.governingReading: Assassin draws his left arm back only slightly to throw.
findings.explanation: The English expands a minimal wind-up into raising the arm overhead.

findings.highlight: the attack that was fired without any indication
findings.evidenceJa: 腕を振り上げる動作さえ見せないアサシンの投擲
findings.governingReading: Assassin’s throw shows not even the motion of raising his arm.
findings.explanation: The English generalizes the exact absence of visible throwing motion into no indication.

findings.highlight: frowns and glares at the black assassin keeping pace with us
findings.evidenceJa: 不快そうに眉を曇らせたまま、併走する黒い暗殺者を一瞥する
findings.governingReading: Still clouding his brow in displeasure, Kotomine casts one glance at the black Assassin running alongside them.
findings.explanation: The English intensifies a single glance into a glare.

findings.highlight: three daggers
findings.evidenceJa: 三条の電光暗器
findings.governingReading: Three streaks of lightning-like concealed weapons fly like bullets.
findings.explanation: The English specifies daggers while omitting the electric-light imagery and the technical concealed-weapon term.

findings.highlight: The course of the attacks is too easy to read for an assassin.
findings.evidenceJa: 山の主を名乗るにしては、読み易い太刀筋だ
findings.governingReading: Kotomine says that for one who calls himself lord of the mountain, Assassin’s attack lines are too readable.
findings.explanation: The English removes the title and recasts the comparison as a generic standard for an assassin.

findings.highlight: Assassin fired three sword flashes.
findings.evidenceJa: アサシンから放たれた紫電は三閃
findings.governingReading: Assassin releases three flashes of purple lightning.
findings.explanation: The English invents swords and drops the purple-lightning image.

findings.highlight: The priest easily knocked them all aside
findings.evidenceJa: 神父は斬って捨てた
findings.governingReading: The priest cuts all three projectiles down without effort.
findings.explanation: The English changes cutting them down into knocking them aside.

findings.highlight: while destroying everything in its path
findings.evidenceJa: 俺たちの居場所を探るように、無秩序な破壊を繰り返しながら
findings.governingReading: Berserker repeatedly destroys the forest at random as though probing for their location.
findings.explanation: The English omits both the apparent search method and the repeated, unordered nature of the destruction.

findings.highlight: It’s just a meaningless warning.
findings.evidenceJa: 余分な忠告だ
findings.governingReading: Kotomine calls it an extra or superfluous warning.
findings.explanation: The English says the warning has no meaning, changing its relevance rather than its necessity.
